# Google Ads / App campaign (UAC) - Brazil creative pack

Package only. NOT uploaded, no asset group created, no budget set, no bid confirmed.

A Google App campaign pulls from asset groups: text assets (headlines, descriptions),
image assets (three ratios), videos (YouTube), and optionally HTML5. Google auto-
assembles the ads. Below is a pt-BR asset group ready to paste/upload.

## Text assets

- `headlines.txt` - 5 headlines, each <= 30 characters
- `descriptions.txt` - 5 descriptions, each <= 90 characters

## Image assets (in this folder, generated by build-uac-images.py)

| File | Size | Ratio | Slot |
|---|---|---|---|
| `img-landscape-1200x628.png` | 1200x628 | 1.91:1 | landscape image |
| `img-square-1200x1200.png` | 1200x1200 | 1:1 | square image |
| `img-portrait-960x1200.png` | 960x1200 | 4:5 | portrait image |

All carry a pt-BR caption + the TUNL wordmark over a real gameplay frame.

## Video

Use the existing pt-BR App Preview upload on YouTube:
`https://youtu.be/7CJsx8_fkQ0`

Google App campaigns want landscape, portrait and square video ideally. Only the one
16:9-ish capture exists. If more ratios are wanted later, re-cut from
`Screenshots/iOS_8.0/br/Simulator Screen Recording ... 20.42.58.mov`.

## Targeting note (user decision, not set here)

Brazil, pt-BR, Android + iOS. Campaign objective: installs. Budget / target CPI / bid
strategy are the user's to set - this pack does not touch them.
